question: How can I contact the University of Ibadan Admission Unit?
answer: For admission enquiries, the Undergraduate Admissions Office page lists this email: uiadmin2011@mail.ui.edu.ng. You can also use the official admissions portal for process notices. Prefer only official ui.edu.ng channels, and confirm contact details on the live University page in case they change.
source: University of Ibadan Undergraduate Admissions Office

sources.title: University of Ibadan Undergraduate Admissions Office

question: What is the official admissions website?
answer: The University of Ibadan undergraduate admissions portal is https://admissions.ui.edu.ng/. Use it for application and screening registration instructions. Always confirm you are on an official University domain before sharing personal information or making payments.
